Bug_Title: CN: Super method is annotated with @OverridingMethodsMustInvokeSuper, but the overriding method isn’t calling the super method. (OVERRIDING_METHODS_MUST_INVOKE_SUPER)
Bug_Details: Super method is annotated with @OverridingMethodsMustInvokeSuper, but the overriding method isn't calling the super method.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the Derived class where the overridden initialize method does not call the super.initialize() method, despite the intention indicated by the now-removed annotation.
Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by calling the showBug method on an instance of Derived, which in turn calls the overridden initialize method without invoking the super method.
